hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean card layout and decent typographic hierarchy, but the circle pack view is cropped at the bottom and the edge bundles collapse into an illegible tangle at center, failing the 'can a viewer extract the data' test.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Correct area encoding throughout — scaleSqrt for force-layout node radii, d3.pack for circle pack, scaleSqrt radial scale for sunburst — with data-driven domains via d3.extent and key functions on all primary joins; hierarchy-link join lacks a key but is benign since it is never re-joined post-init.
flags: Update Storm: force simulation tick calls redrawLinks() (300 bundled-curve path recalculations) on every tick at ~60fps with no RAF coalescing
Update Storm: easing param sliders fire updateLayout() on every input event, each spawning a fresh 1500ms transition mid-flight
Mid-Flight Snap: no explicit .interrupt() on nodeSelection or linkSelection before new layout transitions begin; relies solely on D3 implicit interruption
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Force-layout tick recalculates all 300 bundled edge paths per frame without coalescing, and rapid easing-slider input storms the layout engine with overlapping 1500ms transitions; no explicit interrupt guard protects mid-flight state.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: The circle-pack node clusters are color-distinct and readable (5–6 hues, clear groupings), but the edge bundles converge into a dense radial hairball at the center that makes individual connections untraceable at a glance; the large control surface (8 layout buttons, tension slider, 3 checkboxes, easing selector) adds navigational overhead without aiding immediate comprehension of the current view.
